claims.claim: Researchers at Florida International University combined results from 57 brain imaging studies of adults with sleep disorders.
claims.episode_span: Researchers at Florida International University combined results from 57 brain imaging studies of adults with sleep disorders.
claims.source_title: Scientists discover hidden brain changes linked to common sleep disorders
claims.supporting_quote: To investigate their effects on the brain, scientists at FIU's Center for Children and Families combined and analyzed findings from 57 studies that used brain imaging to examine adults.

claims.claim: A long-term study spanning up to 43 years found that drinking two to three cups of caffeinated coffee each day was associated with markedly lower dementia incidence.
claims.episode_span: A long-term study spanning up to 43 years found that drinking two to three cups of caffeinated coffee each day was associated with markedly lower dementia incidence.
claims.source_title: Drinking 2–3 cups of coffee a day linked to dramatically lower dementia risk
claims.supporting_quote: Drinking two to three cups of caffeinated coffee daily was linked to a dramatically lower risk of dementia and better cognitive functioning in a study spanning up to 43 years.

claims.claim: Researchers at the University of Alicante formally described Copula lucentia, a jellyfish only a few millimeters long, from specimens collected near El Campello.
claims.episode_span: Researchers at the University of Alicante formally described Copula lucentia, a jellyfish only a few millimeters long, from specimens collected near El Campello.
claims.source_title: Scientists discover new jellyfish species in waters off Alicante in Spain
claims.supporting_quote: One of them is Copula lucentia, a tiny jellyfish measuring just a few millimeters. Discovered off El Campello, in Alicante, it was formally described in 2024 by a research team at the University of Alicante (UA) Marine Laboratory in Dénia.

claims.claim: At least 14 million insect species provide ecosystem services that include pollination, waste decomposition, and creation of physical structures used by other animals.
claims.episode_span: At least 14 million insect species provide ecosystem services that include pollination, waste decomposition, and creation of physical structures used by other animals.
claims.source_title: The hidden ways insects support animal life—from habitat to health—go way beyond being food
claims.supporting_quote: There are at least 14 million insect species on Earth, and they play highly diverse roles in sustaining the natural world.

claims.claim: Introduction of deliberate public health interventions in medieval Trondheim coincided with higher rates of roundworm infection in the population.
claims.episode_span: Introduction of deliberate public health interventions in medieval Trondheim coincided with higher rates of roundworm infection in the population.
claims.source_title: The introduction of a medieval public health system exposed the population to roundworm
claims.supporting_quote: Medieval health and sanitation efforts involved deliberate interventions; however, some of these measures had the opposite effect, leading to an increased spread of disease in Trondheim.

claims.claim: The University of Bristol and four partner institutions formed the UK Quantum SuperConnector to convert laboratory quantum discoveries into companies and products.
claims.episode_span: The University of Bristol and four partner institutions formed the UK Quantum SuperConnector to convert laboratory quantum discoveries into companies and products.
claims.source_title: Five leading British universities join forces to turn quantum breakthroughs into world-beating businesses
claims.supporting_quote: Five of Britain’s leading universities have joined forces in a major new initiative designed to transform pioneering British scientific research into successful businesses, high-skilled jobs and cutting-edge technologies.

claims.claim: A plant-derived compound improved survival under stress conditions in the nematode C. elegans.
claims.episode_span: A plant-derived compound improved survival under stress conditions in the nematode C. elegans.
claims.source_title: Plant Extract Boosts Stress Resistance in C. elegans
claims.supporting_quote: Plant Extract Boosts Stress Resistance in C. elegans

claims.claim: Long-term University of Alberta research shows that correcting soil acidity on a crop-by-crop basis fails to protect yields over multiple seasons.
claims.episode_span: Long-term University of Alberta research shows that correcting soil acidity on a crop-by-crop basis fails to protect yields over multiple seasons.
claims.source_title: Why treating soil acidity crop by crop is no longer enough for prairie farmers
claims.supporting_quote: To protect their future harvests, Western Canadian farmers need to manage soil acidity across their entire multiyear rotation rather than crop by crop, long-term research from the University of Alberta suggests.

claims.claim: William Grooms deployed dozens of motion-sensing cameras across Carson National Forest during his first field season of a two-year biodiversity study.
claims.episode_span: William Grooms deployed dozens of motion-sensing cameras across Carson National Forest during his first field season of a two-year biodiversity study.
claims.source_title: Student finds proof of rare wild cat in northern New Mexico
claims.supporting_quote: Armed with dozens of motion-sensing cameras, William Grooms spent this past summer documenting wildlife across Carson National Forest in northern New Mexico. It was his first field season collecting photos for a two-year study to understand how forest structure influences biodiversity in the Southern Rocky Mountains.

claims.claim: A University of Ottawa framework proposing a 26.7-billion-year-old universe without dark matter or dark energy matched several key cosmological observations.
claims.episode_span: A University of Ottawa framework proposing a 26.7-billion-year-old universe without dark matter or dark energy matched several key cosmological observations.
claims.source_title: Theory predicting an older universe without dark matter or dark energy passes key cosmological tests
claims.supporting_quote: An alternative model in which the universe is 26.7 billion years old and needs neither dark matter nor dark energy has held up against several major cosmology tests, according to a new University of Ottawa study.
